Subject: Post-incident follow-up & next steps (DataWave P1)

Alicia / Leo / team — thank you for the quick sync and for joining the bridge. Summary and next steps:

- Root cause (prelim): routing config canary pushed 08:56 PDT sent a subset of traffic to a quantized model variant that had a mismatched input preprocessing check; this surfaced as an increased 503 rate.
- Immediate mitigation: we rolled back the canary at 09:35 PDT; error rate returned to baseline by ~09:40 PDT.
- Why the missed bridge: internal on-call handoff failed; no human on our side acknowledged the calendar invite. Internal postmortem ticket created: INF-1987.
- Action items:
  - (Karthik) Expand the on-call handoff playbook with an explicit "accept calendar invite" step and a dedicated pager acknowledgement within 5 minutes. Due 2026-08-07.
  - (Marissa) Send a one-paragraph summary to affected customers and offer a 1:1 technical review if they'd like deeper details. Due 2026-08-05.
  - (Hannah) Coordinate any commercial remedies / credits with Rishi; propose a small service credit given the missed bridge and customer impact. Due 2026-08-06.

Attached: incident-log-20260803.txt (full), bridge-invite-20260803.ics (record of new bridge).

If DataWave would like a follow-up technical review session, we can schedule one later this week — propose Thu 2026-08-06 11:00 PDT or Fri 2026-08-07 08:00 PDT. Please let me know which works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Apologies again for the coordination gap — we take P1 handling seriously and will follow up on actions above.
